PR (cited in the notes as #21425): fix: Wait for Subscription resources to reach AtLatestKnown [closed]
If using the sync waves annotations currently ArgoCD does not wait for the Subscription to be fully installed. Root cause is that the first update that includes `.status` doesn't include the information that the installation is still pending.

To be able to wait for the operator to be installed, the `.status.state` can be checked.
